column2: There is a moment when the forms stop being forms. The element moves before the thought has finished, and I understand at last why the old masters smiled so little.\n\nI am a master of my element now. There are not many of us alive.

Mastery was supposed to be the end of the road. It was not. In the middle of the night the bending came without being called, and the world went with it.\n\nLet the bards argue about who the greatest bender alive is. They will have one answer now, and the answer will be me.
